title_en: Near Lake I Thate, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with perfect orientation!!!
description_en: At Liqeni I Thate, at FZ Construction, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with perfect orientation. The apartment has a total area of ​​172 m2, of which 126.9 m2 net, 20 m2 veranda and 25 m2 common area. The apartment is located on the top floor of one of the 7-story buildings with an elevator and is organized in the corridor that divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the veranda, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet, two other bedrooms and a toilet with a window. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The complex in which the apartment is located is an honor among the sought after areas as it offers clean air, peace and green spaces. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
